title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the network requests identity information from the UE using IDENTITY REQUEST message.

entities.name: Timer T3570
entities.description: Timer used for retransmission of IDENTITY REQUEST messages during identification procedure.

entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to request identity information from UE.

entities.name: Registration procedure for initial registration
entities.description: Procedure for UE initial registration to the network.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to de-register from the network.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate de-registration procedure.

entities.name: Lower layer failure
entities.description: Condition where lower layer communication fails before IDENTITY RESPONSE is received.

entities.name: Fifth expiry of timer T3570
entities.description: Condition when timer T3570 expires for the fifth time during identification procedure.

entities.name: 5GS registration type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating type of registration (initial, emergency, mobility, periodic).

entities.name: De-registration type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating type of de-registration (e.g., switch off).

entities.name: Procedure abort
entities.description: Network behavior of aborting ongoing procedures under certain conditions.

relations.description: Identification procedure starts timer T3570 for retransmission.
Identification procedure uses IDENTITY REQUEST message.
Lower layer failure condition leads to procedure abort.
Fifth expiry of T3570 leads to procedure abort.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS registration type IE.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains De-registration type IE.
UE-initiated de-registration procedure uses DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Registration procedure for initial registration uses REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
